title: 2004 HMMT February Team Problem 1
statement: Show that any number in row \(n\) (for \(n>0\) ) is at most \(2^{n-1}\).

solutions.text: We use induction on \(n\). It is clear that any number in row 1 is at most \(1=2^{0}\). Now, if every number in row \(n\) is at most \(2^{n-1}\), then every number in row \(n+1\) is the sum of two numbers in row \(n\) and so is at most \(2^{n-1}+2^{n-1}=2^{n}\). This gives the induction step, and the result follows.
